title: AweActions
description: Canonical shape for actions.json sidecars AND for the inline `<!-- AGENT_ACTIONS: {...} -->` JSON block in SKILL.md bodies. The workflow-driver engine at MCP-servers/awe-console/src/workflow-driver.ts:551-595 (actions.json fast-path) and :597+ (inline AGENT_ACTIONS) both consume this shape. Per §0.7c, inline is the canonical authoring source; actions.json is the auto-generated cache.

schema_version.description: Pinned schema version. Required for forward-compat; readers MAY warn on mismatch.

initial_steps.description: Steps run automatically on skill load, BEFORE the first stopping point is presented. Used for setup actions (open browser, fetch context, etc.). Each step is executed via awe-core MCP call.

stopping_points.description: Ordered list of user-input gates. The engine renders the first one's options and STOPS for user choice — no LLM call. After the user selects, that option's `steps` run, then the engine advances to the next stopping_point (or completion).

completion.description: Optional terminal block. Runs after the last stopping_point's steps complete.

summary_template.description: Template string with {{VAR}} substitutions from variables captured during the workflow. Rendered as the final user-facing message.

id.description: Sequential identifier. By convention numbered 1, 2, 3, ... in order.

title.description: Header rendered above the menu (or as the prompt for text_input). Required when type='menu'; falls back to 'Choose' if absent.

type.description: menu = numbered options (default). text_input = free-text prompt; user reply captured into `capture_as`. multi_select / confirm / file_upload = future types reserved by the engine.

capture_as.description: For type='text_input': variable name to capture the user's reply into. Available as {{NAME}} in subsequent step args and the completion summary_template.

options.description: Keyed object {N: option}. KEYS are the strings users type to select (typically '1', '2', '3'). NOT a list of strings — that was the broken fundraising shape, see §0.7b. Empty {} is allowed for type='text_input'.

label.description: Human-readable option text shown in the menu.

vars.description: Variables captured into the workflow context when this option is chosen. e.g. {SCOPE: 'full'}. Available as {{NAME}} in subsequent step args.

steps.description: MCP tool calls executed when this option is chosen, before advancing to the next stopping_point. Empty [] = no auto-execution; the engine just records the choice and advances.

goto.description: Optional branching: jump to the stopping_point with this id (instead of falling through to the next sequential one). Used for skip-ahead or subworkflow patterns.

id.description: Optional identifier for the step. Inferred as 'step_<index>' if absent.

args.description: Tool arguments. String values support {{VAR}} template substitution from workflow variables.

loop.description: Optional loop directive: integer N = repeat step N times; object = future loop config (range, until, etc.).

capture.description: Variable-extraction map: {VAR_NAME: 'field_or_json_path'}. The engine reads the step's output, looks up each value (either a top-level field name or a JSON path) and binds it to the uppercase VAR_NAME. Captured vars are available as {{VAR_NAME}} in subsequent step args and in completion.summary_template. Example: {"SESSION_ID": "session_id"} extracts the 'session_id' field from the tool's output and binds it to SESSION_ID. Engine type at workflow-driver.ts:34 is `capture?: Record<string, string>`.

stream_progress.description: Whether to stream the step's output to the user in real-time (true) or only after completion (false).
